name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement for early-access design partnerships, covering pre-release product access, feedback, confidentiality and intellectual property.

coverPage.title: Design Partner Agreement
coverPage.intro: This Design Partner Agreement (the “Agreement”) consists of: (1) this Cover Page (“**Cover Page**”) and (2) the Common Paper Design Partner Agreement Standard Terms (“**Standard Terms**”). Any modifications of the Standard Terms should be made on the Cover Page, which will control over conflicts with the Standard Terms.
coverPage.attestation: By signing this Cover Page, each party agrees to enter into this Agreement as of the Effective Date.
coverPage.attribution: Common Paper Design Partner Agreement free to use under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

fields.label: Provider
fields.prompt: the provider's legal entity name, the signatory's name and title, and a notice address.

fields.label: Partner
fields.prompt: the design partner's legal entity name, the signatory's name and title, and a notice address.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.prompt: the date the partnership starts, as yyyy-mm-dd.

fields.label: Program
fields.prompt: what the design partner gets access to and what they are expected to do, such as "early access to the beta API in exchange for fortnightly feedback calls".

fields.label: Term
fields.prompt: how long the partnership runs, such as "6 months from the Effective Date".

fields.label: Fees
fields.prompt: what the partner pays, if anything. Design partnerships are often free.

fields.label: Notice Address
fields.prompt: where notices under the agreement are sent, if different from the signature block.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.prompt: the full name of the US state whose law governs, such as "Delaware". Always a state, never a country or a city.

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.prompt: the courts that hear disputes, such as "the state and federal courts located in New Castle County, Delaware".
